verdict.rationale: Gram documents a first-party Platform MCP server: an org admin in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another MCP client can add servers, manage plugins, skills, roles and policies, and read observability data without opening the dashboard (gram-docs-7, gram-docs-22, gram-probe-4). The gram CLI installs toolsets as MCP servers in agents, and agents can be pointed at a single hosted URL (gram-docs-21, gram-docs-11, gram-docs-23). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully to the official MCP server.
